methodology.initialBinaryChecks: HEAD and GET-to-response-headers; body cancelled without reading. Browser-readable at this stage only establishes response/CORS access.
methodology.fullBodyVerification: Four explicitly selected alternatives streamed to memory with32MiB cap and45s timeout; WebCrypto SHA256; ESP image header/partition-layout inspection; no firmware persisted.
methodology.hashEvidenceSource: Expected SHA256 values from the pinned official GitHub release asset digests, captured in asset-api target metadata.
methodology.privacy: No cookies, auth tokens, signed redirect queries, private addresses or third-party catalog author data retained. Task-owned browser was closed and exit verified.
